konkurensi.target: 0 SQLITE_BUSY, 0 error lain, integritas ok (per-agent; bukan klaim parity terkontrol)

token_skill_per_turn.comparison: architectural cost ratio (different corpora/injection), not a like-for-like workload

damnbot.note: Damn-Bot hanya mengirim top-3 (CapSkills 150) + nama skill baru; katalog penuh tidak masuk prompt

hermes.corpus: katalog skill bawaan hermes (seluruh entri di system prompt)

meta.artefact_note: Comparative F2 artefact: keeps the ADR-083 hermes-<sha>-<phase> name and contains both agents.

caveats.engine: Damn-Bot: modernc embedded >=3.51.3, WAL. Hermes: host SQLite 3.45.1, whose WAL-reset guard selects journal_mode=DELETE.
caveats.fairness: Per-agent baseline target (0 SQLITE_BUSY, integrity ok), NOT a controlled parity claim: Damn-Bot shared writers take the session lease and retry ErrSessionBusy (lease busy is not counted as SQLITE_BUSY); hermes appends directly and counts database-is-locked. Both run 4x50 own + 2x50 shared.
caveats.host: Xeon Gold 6152, Linux 6.8.0-41; not the Q14 reference machine and not the F0 machine.
caveats.skill_tokens: Architectural cost ratio, not a same-corpus workload: hermes injects its full builtin catalog (61 entries); Damn-Bot retrieves top-3 of its own 211-skill P1 fixture. Corpora and injection policy differ by design.

meta.llm: 0 call (tidak perlu LLM untuk kedua dimensi)
meta.scenario: 4 proses x 50 turn (sesi sendiri) + 2 proses x 50 turn (sesi SHARED); 1 turn = 1 user + 1 assistant
